fixture_purpose: Answers gate task item 3 unambiguously, because it carries a product consequence.

extracted.DETERMINATION: PROGRAMMATIC ACCESS TO trumprx.gov IS NOT PERMITTED FOR THIS PRODUCT.
extracted.therefore: The site MUST operate on MANUAL CURATION ONLY, and the methodology page MUST say so explicitly.
reasoning_chain: 1. PERMISSION WAS NEVER ESTABLISHED. robots.txt was never retrieved (403). No terms-of-use document was ever retrieved, and domain-restricted search did not even establish that a site-wide terms-of-use page EXISTS. A crawler may not assume permission from silence it has never actually heard. For a YMYL product, the absence of a verified grant is a denial, not a default-allow.

2. THIS ENVIRONMENT IS AFFIRMATIVELY FORBIDDEN TO REACH THE HOST. The session's organizational egress policy denies CONNECT to trumprx.gov:443. The proxy README instructs: 'Do not retry or route around it - report the blocked host.' Building a scraper that depends on an egress path the organization has closed would violate that policy on every run.

3. THE TWO REASONS ARE INDEPENDENT AND POINT THE SAME WAY. Even if the organizational block were lifted tomorrow, reason 1 still stands until robots.txt and the terms are actually read and found permissive. Lifting the block is necessary but not sufficient.

4. THE CONTENT IS PRICE DATA THAT MOVES. Even setting permission aside, an automated feed that silently breaks (returning 403 forever, or worse, stale-but-parseable data) would publish stale drug prices to sick people. Manual curation with an explicit as-of date fails safe; a broken scraper fails dangerously.
extracted.what_would_change_this_determination: ALL of: (a) organizational egress allowlisting of trumprx.gov; AND (b) a direct successful read of https://trumprx.gov/robots.txt showing the target paths are not Disallowed for the intended user-agent; AND (c) a direct read of any terms-of-use document confirming automated retrieval and reproduction of price content is not prohibited. Until all three are satisfied and recorded in a fixture, manual curation is the only defensible mode.
extracted.required_methodology_page_language: TrumpRx.gov pricing on this site is curated MANUALLY. We do not scrape TrumpRx.gov. Automated access to that site has not been established as permitted, and every figure is transcribed by a human reviewer and stamped with the date it was read.
extracted.additional_product_requirement: Because the $199 figure is (per index-mediated reading) limited to the first two fills, the UI must never render a bare '$199/month' for Wegovy Pen or Ozempic. It must render the introductory price, its two-fill duration, AND the post-introductory price together, or render nothing at all.
